Description: Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the caster and adds 5 to all of the caster's RRs vs. spells

When the caster is a target of a spell from the Mentalism, the "incoming" spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal its caster's level. If the "incoming" spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target
As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from the realm of Essence
As Protection I, except bonuses are 10
As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling

Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster. The shield subtracts 10 from all frontal Mentalism attack rolls on the caster (base and elemental). If the caster performs no other actions during a round, he can "parry" (as with a normal shield) one spell attack. The parry bonus is equal to the sum of all the bonuses that the caster would normally have for his spell's base attack roll
As Mind Shield, except is effective only against Essence spells
As Protection I, except bonuses are 15
As Mind Shield, except is effective only against Channeling spells
As Mind Shield, except it is effective against any two of the three realms
As Protection I, except bonuses are 25
As Mind Shield, except is effective against all spells
Gives a +50 to all RRs against all Mentalism spells
As Mind Resistance, except is only effective against Essence spells
As Mind Resistance, except is only effective against Channeling spells
